caption: Shopping for someone who's already done Bourbon Street and beignets twice? Give them a morning in a cypress swamp. Our gift certificates are good on any tour, emailed right away, and they don't expire. #NewOrleans #GiftIdeas #SwampTour #ExperienceGift

slides.headline: For the friend who's done New Orleans twice.
slides.body: They've had the beignets. They've done Bourbon Street. They probably haven't paddled a cypress swamp.

slides.headline: A gift certificate, good on any tour.
slides.body: Manchac, Honey Island, the extended paddle, the rental. They pick the trip and the date.

slides.headline: It lands in their inbox right away.
slides.body: No shipping, no wrapping, no guessing sizes. You check out and it's emailed immediately.

slides.headline: It doesn't expire.
slides.body: Give it in December, use it in April. No use-it-or-lose-it deadline hanging over the gift.

slides.headline: Bare cypress. Fewer bugs. Quiet water.
slides.body: Manchac runs year-round. Gators slow down below 65 degrees and the birds move in. A different trip, still a good one.

slides.headline: Gators wake up. Everything goes green.
slides.body: April through October is peak gator season. Common, never guaranteed.

slides.headline: Skip it for someone who hates the outdoors.
slides.body: Or anyone whose mobility makes kayaking hard. We'd rather say that than sell you the wrong gift.

slides.kicker: What to write on the card
slides.headline: "A real swamp. No motor. No crowd."
slides.body: Then: "Yours whenever you want it." Steal the line. It tells them exactly what's coming.

slides.headline: Any tour. Emailed now. Never expires.
slides.body: The gift for the person who already has a French Quarter print on the wall.

slides.kicker: Tag the friend who needs this
slides.headline: Give them the swamp this year.
slides.body: Gift certificates for small-group kayak swamp tours from New Orleans. Buy them on our site.
